_comment: A lone 60-man Infantry block, reform-before-move off so the order commits its march at once, north of the default hill (Rect2(1150, 380, 250, 200)) quarter-turns to face east (E), which folds its grid: still wide along x and shallow along y, clear of the hill's top edge. It is then ordered east across the hill's top. The fresh order re-squares the grid to the east facing (shallow along x, wide along y) before the destination is checked, so the order is clamped short of the hill's west edge and no man ends up on the hill. Validated in the folded grid instead (main), the destination stood clear at x 1300 and the squared block ended with 4 men on the hill at tick 1000 and 6 at tick 1200; the expect pins on those ticks fail there.
